product.description: Monoprice™EZ™ Series Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount BracketMounts most TVs from 60" ~ 100" to brick, concrete, and wood stud wallsDesigned for easy installation, the Monoprice™ EZ™ Series Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket provides a solid option for mounting 60" ~ 100" TVs to concrete, brick, and wood stud walls. It supports TVs weighing up to 176 pounds, with VESA® mount patters from 200x200 to 900x600. The full‑motion design allows you to adjust the swivel, tilt, and rotation to find the most comfortable viewing angle for almost any seat in the room.Fits VESA® patterns from 200x200 to 900x600Designed for 60" to 100" displaysSupports up to 176 lbs.Swivels ±45 degreesTilts +5/‑15 degreesRotates ±3 degreesExtends from 2.8" to 24.6"UL® certified FULL‑MOTION ARTICULATING WALL MOUNTMonoprice™ Full‑Motion Wall Mounts offer the ultimate in comfort and flexibility. The articulated swing arm allows you to move the TV towards or away from the wall, tilt up or down, and angle from side to side. The plate holding the TV also allows you to rotate the TV to ensure it is level."IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"Check your TV's manual for its VESA® mounting pattern or measure the vertical and horizontal distances between the mounting holes in millimeters. This mount supports VESA patterns from 200x200 to 900x600 and supports TVs weighing up to 176 pounds. The screen size range is only a suggested approximation.
